feed.title: Kroger shoppers are losing money as shocking study reveals hundreds of pricing errors
feed.summary: A new study by the Center for Responsible Food Business (CRFB) reveals that Kroger stores in Ohio have been overcharging customers due to widespread pricing errors. Government inspections found 644 incorrect prices across 389 inspections from 2022 to mid-2026, with overcharges occurring about three times more often than undercharges. Customers were often charged significantly more than the advertised shelf price, with one instance showing a 55% overcharge on eggs due to digital coupon failures.

feed.title: Annamycin Turns “Cold” Pancreatic Tumors “Hot” in New Preclinical Data Presented at AACR
feed.summary: Moleculin Biotech, Inc. announced new preclinical data showing that its drug candidate, Annamycin, can make "cold" pancreatic tumors "hot" by partially mediating its antitumor activity through CD8+ T cells. This suggests Annamycin may not only kill cancer cells directly but also stimulate an immune response, offering a potential strategy for combination therapies in hard-to-treat pancreatic cancer. While Annamycin's primary focus remains relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia, these findings indicate broader therapeutic potential and an unexpected immune-mediated benefit.

feed.title: A cancer drug may help immune cells attack pancreatic tumors, early tests suggest.
feed.summary: Moleculin Biotech announced preclinical findings suggesting its drug Annamycin may help immune cells, specifically CD8+ T cells, target pancreatic tumors. This immune-mediated effect could potentially turn "cold" tumors "hot," making them more susceptible to immune attack. While promising, these results are from preclinical models and Annamycin's primary clinical development remains focused on acute myeloid leukemia, not pancreatic cancer.

feed.title: How Amex Travel Will Use Brand Trust To Win The Luxury Consumer
feed.summary: American Express Travel, led by President Audrey Hendley, is shifting its focus from mere bookings to orchestrating entire luxury travel journeys, emphasizing personalization, ease, and removing friction. This strategy, validated by a 22% growth in travel bookings, aims to leverage Amex's brand trust and extensive network to provide seamless and meaningful experiences, especially for milestone-driven or event-centered trips. The company is betting on its integrated ecosystem and trusted relationships to deliver confidence and deeper travel experiences for its Card Members.

feed.title: CenterPoint Secures $50M to Improve Houston Grid Resiliency
feed.summary: CenterPoint Energy has secured $50 million from the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) to enhance grid resiliency and reliability in the Houston area. This funding is part of the DOE's SPARK initiative, which aims to invest $1.9 billion in grid improvement projects nationwide. CenterPoint will implement Siemens Energy's transmission grid stabilizing technology through Project TALON, a move expected to create over 500 local jobs and bolster the region's energy infrastructure against extreme weather.

feed.title: EXCLUSIVE: Robotics Has A Dell-HP Problem—and This AI Company Wants To Solve It
feed.summary: MBody AI (NASDAQ: MBAI) aims to solve the compatibility problem in robotics, where different machines from various manufacturers often require separate control systems. CEO John Fowler highlights the inefficiency of managing multiple interfaces and compares it to the difficulty of Dell and HP computers not working together. The company's MBody AI Orchestrator is a hardware-agnostic platform designed to provide a centralized solution for managing diverse robotic fleets, focusing on software orchestration and enterprise integration rather than just hardware or AI models.

feed.title: Pfizer Targets Cancer-Related Weight Loss With New Ponsegromab Study
feed.summary: Pfizer Inc. (PFE) is initiating a new Phase 1b clinical study for ponsegromab, targeting adults with non-small cell lung cancer experiencing severe weight loss. The study aims to evaluate the drug's impact on muscle mass and physical function in cancer-related wasting, using a quadruple-masked, placebo-controlled design. This move highlights Pfizer's strategic focus on cancer supportive care, a growing area alongside core oncology treatments, with potential implications for PFE's stock sentiment and the broader cachexia and nutrition market.

feed.title: Dell Stock Jumps as Morgan Stanley Raises Odds of $756 Bull Case
feed.summary: Dell Technologies (DELL) stock rose 4% after Morgan Stanley increased the probability of its $756 bull-case scenario, though it kept its Neutral rating and $511 target unchanged. This adjustment followed a meeting with COO Jeff Clarke, where discussions centered on AI spending's potential to drive infrastructure demand and significantly increase inference-token usage by 2030. The raised probability offers investors a new perspective on Dell's AI infrastructure growth prospects.

feed.title: This is ‘one of the best tax-planning windows’ for retirement savers, says Franklin Templeton’s U.S. head of retirement. Are you jumping on it?
feed.summary: Franklin Templeton's U.S. head of retirement, Steve McKay, emphasizes that traditional retirement guidelines like the 60/40 portfolio and 4% withdrawal rule need an upgrade due to persistent inflation, elevated interest rates, and increased longevity. He highlights the importance of preserving purchasing power, understanding sequence-of-returns risk, and leveraging underutilized tax strategies such as Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) and Roth conversions. McKay also warns against the behavioral mistake of making all-or-nothing investment decisions based on economic concerns, advocating for staying invested over the long term.
